# Celestial Coordinates

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:CelestialCoordinates`](gmeow-CelestialCoordinates.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/CelestialCoordinates>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A point on the celestial sphere expressed as right ascension, declination, and an optional epoch — frame-relative per [Principle 11](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-11). The reference frame (ICRS, FK5, Galactic, etc.) is declared via [`gmeow:coordinateFrame`](../properties/gmeow-coordinateFrame.md).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Entity`](gmeow-Entity.md), [`gufo:Object`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-object)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:CelestialCoordinates`](gmeow-CelestialCoordinates.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Entity`](gmeow-Entity.md), [`gufo:Object`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-object). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:Entity`](gmeow-Entity.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for a point on the celestial sphere — right ascension, declination, optional epoch — when the sky frame (ICRS, FK5, Galactic) is explicit.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for terrestrial points ([`GeoCoordinates`](gmeow-GeoCoordinates.md)) and avoid stating RA/Dec without [`gmeow:coordinateFrame`](../properties/gmeow-coordinateFrame.md) and, for moving bodies, [`gmeow:celestialEpoch`](../properties/gmeow-celestialEpoch.md) ([Principle 11](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-11)).

### How to use

- Mint [`CelestialCoordinates`](gmeow-CelestialCoordinates.md) with [`gmeow:rightAscension`](../properties/gmeow-rightAscension.md) / [`gmeow:declination`](../properties/gmeow-declination.md) / [`gmeow:celestialEpoch`](../properties/gmeow-celestialEpoch.md) and declare the frame via [`gmeow:coordinateFrame`](../properties/gmeow-coordinateFrame.md).

### Examples

- ex:vegaCoords a [`gmeow:CelestialCoordinates`](gmeow-CelestialCoordinates.md); [`gmeow:rightAscension`](../properties/gmeow-rightAscension.md) 279.23; [`gmeow:declination`](../properties/gmeow-declination.md) 38.78; [`gmeow:coordinateFrame`](../properties/gmeow-coordinateFrame.md) [`gmeow:referenceFrameICRS`](../individuals/gmeow-referenceFrameICRS.md).
